snippet.title: CTR Custom Mod: Lockbox Adventure
snippet.description:
​@OblivionPrince and I have been hard at work putting together a custom adventure mod featuring a custom hub world and some of our best tracks.

Some notable features of this mod.
- Hub world with boss races to unlock new areas
- 4 custom characters as boss races
- Bot racers on every track
- Item and wumpa crates
- 14 custom song replacements (barely managed to get that working)
- Purple relics dont actually do anything

Enjoy!

Credits are in the video, but a big shout out to penta3 for making the framework for the custom adventure hub mod.

Download (Requires a legally obtained ROM and a patcher):
https://www.mediafire.com/file/welgu0xmwwvhexr/Lockbox_Adventure.xdelta/file
Play this on Duckstation with 8MB RAM Enabled and 1000% OVERCLOCK IS RECOMMENDED!

Thumbnail (Cover art) by Lockheart

#crashteamracing
